integrations.title: Works with your website
integrations.subtitle: No-code builders and custom-coded sites. We pick the best way to connect for each platform.

methods.wpPlugin: WordPress plugin that applies fixes server-side.
methods.shopifyApp: Shopify app that updates SEO fields and structured data.
methods.wixApp: Wix connection that updates page SEO tags.
methods.webflowApp: Webflow app that updates page SEO fields and CMS items.
methods.sdk: npm SDK that loads approved fixes on your server.
methods.github: Pull requests with fixes for your team to review.
methods.edgeWorker: Cloudflare worker that adds fixes at the edge.
methods.snippet: A one-line snippet pasted into your site's header settings.

sections.p: Account details you give us (name, email, company), the websites, keywords and questions you add, and data from services you connect (such as Google Search Console, with your permission).

Our snippet and plugins send cookieless page-view pings: the page address, the referring address, and whether the visit came from an AI assistant such as chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai or gemini.google.com. They do not use cookies and do not collect personal data about your visitors.
To measure and improve your visibility in search engines and AI answers, to run the service, and to contact you about your account.
We send your prompts and page content to the AI and search-data providers we use to run checks. We don't sell personal data.
Questions about privacy? Email us at the address on our contact page.
We measure how your website appears in search engines and AI answers, diagnose issues and suggest fixes. We do not guarantee rankings or mentions.
Only add websites you own or are authorized to manage. You review and approve every change before we apply it.
Every change we apply can be rolled back. Content is never published without your explicit approval.
